paper_metadata.title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
paper_metadata.abstract: General reasoning represents a long-standing and formidable challenge in artificial intelligence. Recent breakthroughs, exemplified by large language models (LLMs) and chain-of-thought prompting, have achieved considerable success on foundational reasoning tasks. However, this success is heavily contingent upon extensive human-annotated demonstrations, and models' capabilities are still insufficient for more complex problems. Here we show that the reasoning abilities of LLMs can be incentivized through pure reinforcement learning (RL), obviating the need for human-labeled reasoning trajectories. The proposed RL framework facilitates the emergent development of advanced reasoning patterns, such as self-reflection, verification, and dynamic strategy adaptation. Consequently, the trained model achieves superior performance on verifiable tasks such as mathematics, coding competitions, and STEM fields, surpassing its counterparts trained via conventional supervised learning on human demonstrations. Moreover, the emergent reasoning patterns exhibited by these large-scale models can be systematically harnessed to guide and enhance the reasoning capabilities of smaller models.

extraction_data.innovation: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to incentivize long chain-of-thought reasoning without a value model; decoupled RL infrastructure with asynchronous scheduling to overlap rollout, inference, and rule-based reward computation; data packing and DualPipe pipeline parallelism to minimize padding and maximize throughput; Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) for self-speculative decoding acceleration.
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: DeepSeek-V3 pretraining corpus (high-quality web text, code, mathematics)
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Reinforcement learning (GRPO) with rule-based and reward-model signals, Outcome-based reinforcement learning, Supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning, Supervised fine-tuning (distillation), Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by reinforcement learning, Reinforcement learning (RL) for reasoning, Reinforcement learning (GRPO) for reasoning; supervised fine-tuning for cold start and distillation
extraction_data.extension: Distillation pipeline fine-tunes base models (Qwen2.5-Math 1.5B/7B/14B/32B, Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct) for 2–3 epochs on 800k distilled reasoning samples using cosine decay LR.
extraction_data.research_problem: Aligning emergent reasoning capabilities with human preferences and improving broader task performance beyond narrow reasoning tasks.
extraction_data.application: Mathematical reasoning, code generation, natural language understanding, complex instruction following
extraction_data.paper_title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
extraction_data.finetuning_data: 66, 000 preference pairs for helpful reward model; 106, 000 prompts for safety reward model; general instruction data and preference-based rewards, DeepSeek-V3 SFT data (non-reasoning), C-Eval, GPQA, SimpleQA, AIME, MATH, CNMO, DeepSeek-R1-Zero trajectories, mathematical and coding datasets, 800k distilled reasoning samples
extraction_data.hardware_description: 16 H800 GPUs for inference demo; large-scale GPU cluster for training
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Multi-stage: Rejection Sampling -> Reinforcement Learning -> Supervised Fine-Tuning
extraction_data.reasoning_mode: Chain-of-thought with self-reflection, verification, and dynamic strategy adaptation; aligned with human preferences via non-reasoning data
extraction_data.synthetic_data_generation_method: LLM-generated reasoning traces refined by human verification and DeepSeek-V3 for formatting and language consistency
extraction_data.rl_algorithm: GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization), Reinforcement Learning (RL), PPO, DPO, GRPO
extraction_data.reward_mechanism: Rule-based rewards based on correctness of final predictions against ground-truth answers, Rule-based rewards for math and code; language consistency reward, Rule-based rewards (code executor, answer matcher, format checker) and model-based rewards from a reward model, Helpful reward model and Language Consistency (LC) reward, Hybrid: rule-based rewards for math/code, reward model for general reasoning, Rule-based rewards (format, accuracy, helpfulness), Rule-based rewards (accuracy, format, safety) with no reward model
extraction_data.safety_evaluation_protocol: Open-source and in-house safety evaluation benchmarks, multiple languages, jailbreak attacks
extraction_data.safety_defect_rate: Unsafe rate ~10%, Rejection rate ~25% (with risk control system)
extraction_data.optimizer_innovation: GRPO simplifies PPO by using a group of outputs to estimate advantages, reducing resource consumption.
